fields.intent: Capture day reached, expedition, hunger, energy, resources, bag, room, signal, and observed detour cause.
fields.translationNote: Keep numeric data language-independent; resource order is wood/stone/food/driftwood.

fields.ko: 채집 대상으로 판단한 근거와 첫 실패 뒤 행동
fields.en: Evidence used to identify a gatherable target and the action after the first failure
fields.intent: Separate discovery from resource shortage.
fields.translationNote: Record behavior; do not ask whether gathering was obvious.

fields.ko: 물 진입 전후 위험 예상 근거와 복귀 행동
fields.en: Risk expectation and return behavior before and after entering water
fields.intent: Capture perceived and actual swimming pressure.
fields.translationNote: Do not describe the intended risk before the session.

fields.ko: 장벽 앞 첫 시도와 다음 선택
fields.en: First attempt at the barrier and the next choice
fields.intent: Measure barrier and tool discovery from behavior.
fields.translationNote: Do not include the stone-axe answer in the participant-facing label.

fields.en: World-facility approach, prompt, input, and popup behavior
fields.intent: Verify the spatial facility loop without a global-menu assumption.
fields.translationNote: Keep arrows or reorder the full sentence naturally; never concatenate fragments.

fields.ko: 제작·연구 중 먼저 고른 것과 화면 근거
fields.en: First choice between crafting and research and the on-screen evidence used
fields.intent: Capture prioritization without stating a correct order.
fields.translationNote: Do not imply that either action must come first.

fields.ko: 가방 확장과 함께 포기하거나 미룬 선택
fields.en: Choice deferred or abandoned when considering the bag upgrade
fields.intent: Measure investment tension from observed action.
fields.translationNote: UNREACHED or no tradeoff observed is valid.

fields.ko: 방 미리보기·확정 때 비교한 후보와 미룬 선택
fields.en: Room candidates compared and choice deferred during preview or commitment
fields.intent: Capture optional room-investment tension.
fields.translationNote: Do not imply that a room must be committed.

fields.ko: 구조 신호 1·2단계 부족 상태 뒤 행동
fields.en: Behavior after a missing-requirement state at rescue signal stage 1 or 2
fields.intent: Separate requirement feedback from raw scarcity.
fields.translationNote: Keep stage as structured data where possible.

fields.ko: compact A를 처음 본 대상·시각과 실제 입력
fields.en: Object, time, and actual input at first compact A exposure
fields.intent: Use behavior as discovery evidence.
fields.translationNote: Do not expose the internal name compact A to the participant.

fields.ko: 안내가 가린 대상, 잘린 글자, 반복 행동
fields.en: Occluded object, clipped text, or repeated action
fields.intent: Record concrete readability failures without a leading clarity question.
fields.translationNote: Keep examples out of the participant-facing prompt.

fields.ko: 플레이하는 동안 무엇을 가장 먼저 하려고 했나요? 그렇게 생각한 화면이나 사건은 무엇이었나요?
fields.en: What did you try to do first while playing? What on screen or in the game led you to that?
fields.intent: Elicit the player's perceived goal without naming the intended loop.
fields.translationNote: Do not add example goals.

fields.ko: 허기와 체력 때문에 원래 하려던 일을 바꾼 순간이 있었나요? 있었다면 무엇을 바꿨나요?
fields.en: Did hunger or energy make you change what you planned to do? If so, what did you change?
fields.intent: Separate felt survival pressure from resource scarcity.
fields.translationNote: Use the runtime's established EN terms for hunger and energy.

fields.ko: 돌도끼, 밧줄, 장벽, 물은 각각 어떤 의미라고 생각했나요?
fields.en: What did you think the stone axe, rope, barrier, and water each meant?
fields.intent: Test the player's mental model without stating correct functions.
fields.translationNote: Do not append the intended answers.

fields.ko: 가방, 방, 구조 신호 중 무엇에 먼저 자원을 썼거나 쓰지 않았나요? 그 이유는 무엇인가요?
fields.en: Which of the bag, room, or rescue signal did you spend resources on first, or defer? Why?
fields.intent: Reveal optional-investment tension without a preferred answer.
fields.translationNote: Reorder nouns naturally; do not imply all three must be purchased.

fields.ko: 마지막 결과가 왜 발생했다고 생각하나요? 다음 한 번에 가장 먼저 다르게 할 일은 무엇인가요?
fields.en: Why do you think the final result happened? What would you do differently first on another run?
fields.intent: Compare player attribution with game and observer evidence.
fields.translationNote: Do not name possible failure causes in the question.

fields.intent: Keep result aggregation language-independent.
fields.translationNote: Localize display labels but store the enum.

fields.intent: Tie the outcome to the five-day calendar.
fields.translationNote: Store the integer or not_applicable enum; localize the label only.

fields.intent: Measure time to conclusion without inferring success quality.
fields.translationNote: Use elapsed MM:SS from the first controllable frame.

fields.intent: Keep game communication separate from interpretation.
fields.translationNote: Summarize the displayed text; do not overwrite it with the observer's diagnosis.

fields.intent: Preserve the player's own attribution.
fields.translationNote: Do not correct the answer in this field.

fields.en: Direct cause supported by the behavior record
fields.intent: Document evidence-backed diagnosis and label inference.
fields.translationNote: Prefix unsupported interpretation with INFERENCE/추정.

gaps.reason: No human result is fabricated; this packet is the blank intake form.
KO 3 and EN 3 first-user sessions have not been run.
Final Wave 12 evidence used synthetic gamepad input only.
Compact A 12/12 passes, but the broader qps-long visual gate fails 6 of 10 cases.
No fresh no-grant/no-warp Day 4-5 natural route with a complete frozen-value ledger.
Bag 4-to-6 regression passes, but purchase followed by a natural rescue route is not independently evidenced.
Runtime PASS does not adopt unselected art candidates.
Steam App ID, store name, official English title, and distribution checks remain TBD.

requiredBeforeBalanceDecision: reproducible natural-play evidence of the same bottleneck or the existing six-session external threshold
